title: Compact variant pruning and token alignment for charts and table atoms
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Scope: Reduce variant bloat across chart and table components by removing micro-variants (density, padding, legacy color variants), align token usage to the updated semantic token map, fix auto-layout constraints for responsive rows and stacked chart atoms, and add a gated publish pipeline with automated preflight checks. Goals: 1) Reduce figma file weight and accidental variant proliferation for downstream consumers; 2) Ensure all visual states reference semantic tokens (colors/typography/spacing) to support theme swaps and token migrations; 3) Stabilize auto-layout so table rows and chart legends don’t detach in responsive instances; 4) Add a publish checklist that runs a plugin lint and a small PR template to reduce regressions. Deliverables: consolidated chart atom variants (3 canonical variants), normalized table row component with density token, published library version, Confluence short-runbook for follow-ups, and a small visual regression checklist for QA.
acceptance_criteria: All removed micro-variants are documented in the migration mapping
Chart and table instances across the dashboard pages update without manual rework in >90% cases
Auto-layout constraints are fixed for responsive breakpoints used by product pages
Published UI kit passes plugin lint (no hard-coded colors) and the release notes describe token changes

decisions: Keep three canonical chart variants (default, compact, and fullscreen) and remove density-by-token micro-variants
All color and spacing must reference tokens from the new semantic map before publishing
Legacy variants retained under a 'legacy/' prefix for two sprints; automated search/replace will be scheduled during the next maintenance window
Publishing gated by plugin lint and a visual sanity checklist executed by QA on a sample of dashboard pages
